text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — prod-us-east1 proxy emitting anomalous auth traffic (spike from service-account 'relay-processor'). Creating triage thread. Thread root 4781234567

maria-oncall: I'm on pager, looking now. seeing a sudden outbound fanout from one pool.

john-sre: Confirmed. ~8k outbound sessions in last 3m from pods labeled app=relay-processor -> many external IPs. Holding any deploys.

lina-sec: Attaching forensic collection. Suspect compromised service-account key or debug-logger leak. Starting packet capture & index of logs.

sam-platform: I can temporarily block egress for that node pool. Recommend denylist to stop bleed while we investigate.

maria-oncall: Can we isolate with a canary rule first? block small CIDR set and watch.

john-sre: Rolling canary deny for 35.200.120.0/22 and 34.68.0.0/16 to test impact.

john-sre: run these to inspect pods:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=relay-processor -o wide
kubectl -n inference exec -it <pod> -- ss -tunp | grep ESTAB
```

lina-sec: In logs I see debug dumps from idx-logger showing token fragments like 'sk-rt_' that look like service keys. Querying ELK for `message:/*sk-rt_*/`. This is high risk for credential exposure.

tess-cs: Any customer impact yet? I've got 2 support tickets citing auth failures and higher latencies for some orgs. Ticket refs: #4567, #4589.

andrew-legal: Pause external comms until scope confirmed. Notify privacy if PII may be in logs. Keep internal notes for potential disclosure.

maria-oncall: Action items: 1) isolate egress (sam) 2) rotate relay-processor keys (sam & lina) 3) scrub/redact leaked logs (lina) 4) triage customer impact (tess) 5) assign postmortem (maria). Who will execute rotation?

sam-platform: I'll take rotation. Plan: generate new key, push to secrets-manager (relay-processor/keys:v3), create new KMS envelope. Then restart pods. Lina to revoke old key after new key validated.

lina-sec: I'll prepare revocation steps and forensic snapshot. Proposed sequence:
1) snapshot logs (immutable export)
2) scrub live indices for token patterns (coordinate with observability)
3) revoke old keys in IAM/KMS
4) rotate secrets entry -> rollout

john-sre: Example disable command (placeholder):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable --user-project=myproj --key=RELAY-KEY-ID
```

lina-sec: Also running queries to find where debug-logger forwarded full payloads. Looks like a misconfigured loglevel in staging forwarder accidentally enabled in a subset of relay pods.

tess-cs: Drafting customer note: "We detected unusual auth traffic originating from an internal service; we are rotating credentials and investigating. No confirmed customer data access at this time." Holding for legal sign-off.

andrew-legal: Draft looks fine. Do not name affected customers yet. Send to privacy and incident commander for approval.

sam-platform: Rotated key for relay-processor and uploaded secrets-manager:relay-processor/keys:v3. Restarting pods with new secret. Will monitor for failures.

maria-oncall: Egress denylist applied -> outbound sessions dropped ~92%, consistent with block working. Early telemetry: CPU/latency normalizing.

lina-sec: Forensics update: found ~12 external destination IPs, repeated TLS handshakes at odd hours. Collecting who accessed secrets-manager for the key last week. Suspect automated leak rather than human credential theft.

tess-cs: Created INFSEC ticket INFSEC-789 for customer comms and tracking. Preparing a one-off message template once legal approves.

andrew-legal: Privacy looped in, will advise on disclosure threshold. Keep log export chain intact.

maria-oncall: Handoff: oncall-night taking over monitoring and next steps. @john-sre will remain as escalation contact. Handoff timestamp 4781234800.

john-sre: I'll keep watch and follow up with a full incident page once we finish key revocation and log scrub.

lina-sec: Leaving initial evidence bundle in /forensics/incidents/4781234567. Will post hashes and timeline in the incident tracker.

maria-oncall: Good work team. Summary for bridge: blocked egress, rotated relay-processor key, started log scrub & forensic export, customer-impact under investigation. Next: confirm no PII in leaked logs, finalize comms, postmortem owner assigned. :lock: :email:
